games.title: Manndew Island
games.description: A cozy Godot 4 co-op adventure for up to four players. Share a tropical island: explore monster paths, keep a shop, craft, harvest, and uncover story beats together. Built by our family for PC — LAN co-op, pixel art, and plenty of silly haggle comebacks.

games.title: Sky Drift
games.description: Steer a fighter through lakes and sky, upgrade your airframe, call wingmen, and dogfight AI enemies. Mouse to fly, Space to boost, click or F for guns — play right in your browser.

games.title: Open Roads 3D
games.description: Garage, cash, damage and repair, and a big roster of cars across an open 3D world. Built for keyboard and touch — jump in and hit the road in your browser.

games.title: Wave Tester
games.description: Pilot a boat on live Gerstner waves with buoys, crates, and sea-state presets. A 3D ocean playground — tweak the sea and ride it in your browser.

games.title: Chicken Defense
games.description: Defend the main tower from chickens, earn chicken nuggets, and buy towers and upgrades. A Scratch tower-defense by Dogo-games — play right in your browser.

games.title: Adventure Platformer
games.description: Explore, jump, and adventure with friends using Scratch cloud multiplayer. Arrow keys or WASD to move — open it here and start playing.

games.title: Glow Ball 2
games.description: Steer with the mouse, dodge red arrows, gather XP, and climb levels — including boss fights and a brutal nightmare mode. Play the Scratch original here.

games.title: Tile Platformer Creator
games.description: Paint a platformer with tiles, press space to play your level, and share codes with friends. A creative Scratch tool from Dogo-games.

games.title: Inside the Notebook
games.description: A Scratch roguelike set inside a notebook. Click the card to open the embedded player and dive in.

games.title: Risk it for the Biscuit
games.description: Tile-by-tile arrow-key movement across seven tough levels. Die and you restart the whole run — can you risk it for the biscuit?
